# Fandango

> > Fandango is a leading movie ticketing and entertainment platform offering exclusive movie bundles, collectibles, and merchandise tied to major film releases.

Fandango provides moviegoers with access to tickets, special edition collectibles like popcorn buckets and pins, and exclusive movie-themed merchandise bundles. The platform partners with major studios including Disney to offer limited-time promotional items and experiences for blockbuster films.
